title: Advisory Decision
description: JSON schema for advisory governance decisions emitted by the Demerzel Policy Engine.

decision_id.description: Unique identifier for the decision event.

subject.description: The entity or action being evaluated (e.g., issue URL, PR, transition attempt).

reason_codes.description: List of reason codes (e.g., RISK_001, DOR_001) justifying the decision.

transition_result.description: Details about the requested lifecycle state transition.

from_state.description: The current state before the transition.

allowed.description: Whether the transition is permitted according to the state machine.

blocking_reasons.description: Reasons why the transition is blocked, if applicable.

evidence_refs.description: References to logs, diffs, or artifacts used as evidence.
